description: This file defines the server-side logic for the AdminLeaderboard web page in an Online Examination System. It includes event handlers for page load and button clicks, with some code commented out that interacts with a SQL database, such as fetching user info and filtering data based on semester.

classes.name: AdminLeaderboard
classes.description: Partial class for the AdminLeaderboard web page, inheriting from System.Web.UI.Page, handling page events and user interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load; currently does not execute any code, but contains commented-out code for initializing data from database.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handler for Home button click, transfers user to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handler for Profile button, transfers to AdminQueue.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handler for Leaderboard button; currently empty.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Handler for search button; sets session variable for semester, contains commented-out database query code.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handler for logout button; transfers user to LoginPage.aspx.
